topic.title: Limitations of the BiDi Support
topic.shortdesc: Known limitations when editing bidirectional (BiDi) documents in .

body.p:
supports editing bidirectional (BiDi) documents with the following limitations:
Ligatures are broken when:
A part of a word is surrounded by an element. It works correctly in Chrome when the Tags Display Mode is No Tags.
A tag can point in the wrong direction when rendering elements that contain both RTL (Right to Left) and LTR (Left to Right) content.
Tables are not resizable in RTL (Right to Left) documents.
